name: DES16E2cxw field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the Type Ia supernova DES16E2cxw, seen by Hubble.
label: des16e2cxw-hubble
story: Hubble came to this patch of sky to follow DES16E2cxw, a Type Ia supernova found by the Dark Energy Survey. Explosions like this one serve as cosmic yardsticks for tracing how the universe has expanded and for probing dark energy.

claims.text: DES16E2cxw is a Type Ia supernova (SNIa) at RA 00:40:42.70, Dec -43:55:18.5
DES16E2cxw was found by the Dark Energy Survey
Hubble program 14216 (RAISIN2) observed Type Ia supernovae to trace cosmic expansion and constrain dark energy
Type Ia supernovae serve as standard candles (cosmic yardsticks)
